title: Jen and the Wax
lines: Mom has an ax and a log.
The ax is big. Jen tugs at it.
"Do not tug at it," said Mom.
Jen rubs wax on the log.
Mom sets the log up. Jen is not sad.
Mom and Jen sit on the log.
scoring_note: This passage says "do not", "is not". Decodability forbids apostrophes. A child who reads "don't" or "isn't" is reading for meaning — do not score it an error.
